defect.name: publishing provider intent before local lease acquisition can create a false unresolved tombstone without any provider entry
defect.exact_source_reason: NotionAccountPool.lease().__aenter__ can fail locally with AccountPoolCoolingDown/AccountPoolExhausted before any Notion client operation. If Stage-B writes begin_provider_intent before entering the lease, that purely local routing failure leaves a durable unresolved intent. A later exact retry then fails closed forever even though provider_call_count was zero.

local_model.safe_order: lease acquisition/local route -> strict intent publication -> provider

required_stage_b_order: read/gate durable state and resolve exact retry before any new route
acquire/select local account lease; no provider call yet
enter provider exactly once with failover disabled for this intent
strictly finalize durable state and clear intent
next: The exact Stage-B server materializer must place begin_provider_intent inside an already-acquired lease but immediately before lease.run(provider), and combine this with V36 allow_failover=false.
